meta.title: Sjórseiðr — site map
meta.note: Single source of truth for the top nav (nav.js, index.html, section.html), the home page's section cards, and each section landing page (section.html?sec=<id>). A section with a top-level "href" is a direct nav item: its nav link and home card go straight to that page instead of a section landing, and its "cards" list its member pages (used for the active-nav highlight and the in-page pair toggle). Add a card here and it appears in the section page and the home-page count.
